✦♡
Little pieces of us

Three little memories ♡

Choose one, my love.

Our Nikkah Day ♡

Our nikkah day — and of course one of our absolute favorite picture.❤️ The day ALLAH made you my Mehram and me yours. ❤️🫂The day our love became a promise, our hearts found their home, 🫂 and our forever officially began. 6 months of being yours and inshALLAH lifetime to go.❤️♾️❤️

Our Gajras ♡

The first time we met after our Nikah, you stopped your car, called someone, and then that guy came and gave you gajras. 🥹❤️ It was such a surprise for me, and I loved that little gesture. I love you so much. 💋💋💋 And then one day, you randomly sent me a picture of gajras that you saw on the road, aur mujhy bola ke ‘yeh gajray dekh kar mujhy aapki yaad aayi.’ 🥹🥹 Aur jab bhi main hamari pictures gallery mein dekhti hoon, I don’t know why, mujhy aapki aur bhi zyada yaad aane lagti hai. 🥺🥺 And I miss your hands… 🥺 Jinhein pakar kar lagta tha ke sab theek hai. Haan, heartbeat 2x ki speed par ho jati thi 😂❤️ but somehow, it felt so good. ❤️💋 You know na… you’re my whole world. 🌍❤️ And I love every little memory that reminds me of you. 🥹❤️

Our Sleep Calls ♡

Yeh hamari saath sone ki cutest pictures mein se ek hai. 🥺❤️ Nikah ke baad se hum almost rozana call par saath sotay hain, aur mujhy ab call par aapke saath sone ki aadat si ho gayi hai. 🥺 Agar kabhi call nahi hoti, pata nahi kyun, mera dil hi nahi karta sone ka. 🥺❤️ It feels so comforting just knowing that you’re there, even if we’re miles apart. Bas ab jaldi jaldi se yeh 73 days guzar jayein, aur phir main aapke paas aa jaoon. 🥹❤️ Calls ki bajaye, phir hum actually ek hi blanket mein saath soya karein, japhiii daal ke, bilkul paas paas. 🫂❤️ I can’t wait for those nights with you. 🥺❤️🫂
